question: What model has the most different versions?
gold_query: SELECT Model FROM CAR_NAMES GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT model_list.Model, COUNT(DISTINCT car_names.Model) AS Number_of_Versions FROM model_list JOIN car_names ON model_list.ModelId = car_names.MakeId GROUP BY model_list.Model ORDER BY Number_of_Versions DESC LIMIT 1"}
